description: The municipality republishes DPC structural building aggregates derived mainly from regional topographic building databases and split using ISTAT 2021 administrative boundaries. The source describes nationally harmonised derived polygons but cautions that the original building inputs differ in origin and date. The Copertino distributions declare IDAG, sequential Label and municipality fields. Shapefile packaging uses EPSG 7794 and GeoJSON uses EPSG 4326. These formats represent the same local extract. Coverage is Copertino, Puglia, Italy. The package declares the CC BY 4.0 licence; its description separately attributes CC BY4.0 to DPC and IODL2.0 to the Puglia inputs. Those distinct rights are retained without treating them as interchangeable. The public catalogue provides descriptive metadata and the listed distribution links. Costs, access conditions for later file use and present completeness remain unknown. The supplied facts come from source descriptions and distribution labels; data values and file contents were not inspected. No specific simulation method is documented. Related resources may overlap this inventory or time period, but no further exact relationship is established by the inspected metadata.
